import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] Comb = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] A = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] B = new long[32][32];
    static long TT;
    static int R, C, n;
    static char[] p = new char[110];
    static long[][] CC = new long[32][32];
    static long MM;
    static List<pll>[][] P = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static List<pll>[][] Q = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static long Res = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                P[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                Q[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    static class pll implements Comparable<pll> {
        long first, second;

        pll(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(pll o) {
            if (this.first != o.first) {
                return Long.compare(this.first, o.first);
            }
            return Long.compare(this.second, o.second);
        }
    }

    static void Put(int x, int y, long g, long c1, long c2, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            P[x][ck].add(new pll(g, c1));
            if (c2 != 0) Q[x][ck].add(new pll(g, c2));
            return;
        }
        Put(x + 1, y, g + (! (ck != 0) ? A[x + 1][y] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), ck);
        Put(x, y + 1, g + (ck != 0 ? B[x][y + 1] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), ck);
    }

    static void Calc1(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            List<pll> list = P[x][ck];
            if (list.isEmpty()) return;
            int t = lowerBound(list, new pll((TT + 1) / 2 - g, 0));
            if (t != list.size() && list.get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            if (t > 0 && list.get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0) Calc1(x - 1, y, g + (! (ck != 0) ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        if (y > 0) Calc1(x, y - 1, g + (ck != 0 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
    }

    static void Calc2(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            List<pll> list = Q[x][ck];
            int t = lowerBound(list, new pll((TT + 1) / 2 - g, 0));
            if (t != list.size() && list.get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) {
                    Res += list.get(t).second;
                }
            }
            if (t > 0 && list.get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (list.get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) {
                    Res += list.get(t - 1).second;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0 && p[x + y - 1] != 'B') Calc2(x - 1, y, g + (! (ck != 0) ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        if (y > 0 && p[x + y - 1] != 'A') Calc2(x, y - 1, g + (ck != 0 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
    }

    static void Make(List<pll> P) {
        if (P.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(P);
        int cnt = 0;
        long s = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < P.size(); i++) {
            s += P.get(i).second;
            if (i == P.size() - 1 || P.get(i).first != P.get(i + 1).first) {
                P.set(cnt++, new pll(P.get(i).first, s));
                s = 0;
            }
        }
        while (P.size() > cnt) P.remove(P.size() - 1);
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<pll> list, pll key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).compareTo(key) < 0) low = mid + 1;
            else high = mid;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = br.readLine().toCharArray();

        for (int i = 0; i <= 61; i++) {
            Comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Comb[i][j] = Comb[i - 1][j - 1] + Comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        n = R + C;
        TT = Comb[n * 2][R * 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    A[i][j] = Comb[i - 1][R - 1] * (Comb[n * 2 - i][R] - Comb[j][R]);
                }
                if (j > 0) {
                    B[i][j] = Comb[j - 1][R - 1] * (Comb[n * 2 - j][R] - Comb[i][R]);
                }
            }
        }

        CC[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (i != n && p[i + j] != 'B') CC[i + 1][j] += CC[i][j];
                if (j != n && p[i + j] != 'A') CC[i][j + 1] += CC[i][j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            if (p[i + R - 1] != 'B') {
                Put(R, i, A[R][i], Comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[R - 1][i], 0);
            }
            if (p[i + R - 1] != 'A') {
                Put(i, R, B[i][R], Comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[i][R - 1], 1);
            }
        }

        for (int i = R; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                Make(P[i][j]);
                Make(Q[i][j]);
            }
        }

        MM = TT + 1;
        Calc1(n, n, 0, 0);
        Calc1(n, n, 0, 1);
        Calc2(n, n, 0, 0);
        Calc2(n, n, 0, 1);
        System.out.println(Res);
    }
}
